data.body: **[P2] Check context restoration in the thread that runs plugin hooks.** Both this comparison and `before` execute on the caller thread, while the base SDK runs plugin Start/End inside `contextvars.copy_context().run` on its invocation worker. Leaked worker bindings cannot change the caller's context, so this reports successful restoration even if the plugin omits its detach calls. Capture context immediately before delegate Start and after delegate End in the owning worker context, and add a negative control that suppresses actual detachment rather than editing the recorded boolean.
